package course

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
)

func TestClientUsesAtomicGeneratedCourseEnsureContract(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		if request.Method != http.MethodPost || request.URL.Path != "/internal/generated-courses" {
			http.NotFound(writer, request)
			return
		}
		if request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != "course-token" ||
			request.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key") != "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111" {
			t.Errorf("unexpected auth/idempotency headers")
		}
		var payload domain.GeneratedCourse
		if err := json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("decode request: %v", err)
		}
		if payload.Fingerprint != "fingerprint" || payload.Status != "ACTIVE" || payload.CatalogVisible {
			t.Errorf("unexpected generated Course payload: %#v", payload)
		}
		writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
		_ = json.NewEncoder(writer).Encode(domain.EnsureCourseResult{
			CourseID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", Reused: false,
			Lessons: []domain.CourseLessonBinding{{
				LessonID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", LessonRevisionID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", Order: 0,
				Targets: []domain.TargetRef{{Type: domain.TargetConcept, Key: "go.syntax", Version: "v1"}},
			}},
		})
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "course-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	result, err := client.EnsureCourse(context.Background(), domain.GeneratedCourse{
		Fingerprint: "fingerprint", Status: "ACTIVE",
	}, "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ensure course: %v", err)
	}
	if result.CourseID != "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222" || result.Reused ||
		result.Lessons[0].LessonRevisionID != "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected result: %#v", result)
	}
}

func TestClientMapsGeneratedCourseContractErrors(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name          string
		status        int
		body          string
		wantDomainErr error
		wantStatusErr string
	}{
		{
			name:          "malformed request",
			status:        http.StatusBadRequest,
			body:          `{"error":{"code":"invalid_request"}}`,
			wantDomainErr: domain.ErrValidation,
		},
		{
			name:          "unsupported course reference",
			status:        http.StatusUnprocessableEntity,
			body:          `{"error":{"code":"unsupported_course_reference"}}`,
			wantDomainErr: domain.ErrValidation,
		},
		{
			name:          "idempotency conflict",
			status:        http.StatusConflict,
			body:          `{"error":{"code":"idempotency_conflict"}}`,
			wantDomainErr: domain.ErrConflict,
		},
		{
			name:          "upstream internal error",
			status:        http.StatusInternalServerError,
			body:          `{"error":{"code":"internal_error"}}`,
			wantStatusErr: "course returned status 500",
		},
	}

	for _, testCase := range tests {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
				if request.Method != http.MethodPost || request.URL.Path != "/internal/generated-courses" {
					t.Errorf("unexpected request: %s %s", request.Method, request.URL.Path)
				}
				if request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != "course-token" ||
					request.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key") != "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111" {
					t.Errorf("missing Course authorization or idempotency header")
				}
				writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
				writer.WriteHeader(testCase.status)
				_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(testCase.body))
			}))
			defer server.Close()

			client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "course-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
			_, err := client.EnsureCourse(context.Background(), domain.GeneratedCourse{
				Fingerprint: "fingerprint", Status: "ACTIVE",
			}, "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111")
			if err == nil {
				t.Fatal("expected Course contract error")
			}
			if testCase.wantDomainErr != nil {
				if !errors.Is(err, testCase.wantDomainErr) {
					t.Fatalf("error = %v, want %v", err, testCase.wantDomainErr)
				}
				return
			}
			if err.Error() != testCase.wantStatusErr {
				t.Fatalf("error = %v, want %q", err, testCase.wantStatusErr)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestClientRejectsGeneratedCourseAboveContractLimitBeforeHTTP(t *testing.T) {
	calls := 0
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(http.ResponseWriter, *http.Request) { calls++ }))
	defer server.Close()
	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "course-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	_, err := client.EnsureCourse(context.Background(), domain.GeneratedCourse{
		Description: strings.Repeat("x", domain.MaximumGeneratedCoursePayloadBytes),
	}, "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111")
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) || calls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("oversized Course: calls=%d err=%v", calls, err)
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticCatalogExactCoursePayloadAndRedirectDoesNotLeakToken(t *testing.T) {
	redirectCalls := 0
	target := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		redirectCalls++
		if r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != "" {
			t.Error("redirect leaked token")
		}
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	}))
	defer target.Close()
	source := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { http.Redirect(w, r, target.URL, http.StatusFound) }))
	defer source.Close()
	client := Client{BaseURL: source.URL, InternalToken: "write", DiagnosticCatalogToken: "secret", HTTPClient: source.Client()}
	_, err := client.GetDiagnosticAssessmentCatalog(context.Background(), "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222")
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid) || redirectCalls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("redirect err=%v calls=%d", err, redirectCalls)
	}

	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != "secret" {
			t.Errorf("diagnostic token mismatch: %q", r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"))
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"schema":"course-diagnostic-assessment-catalog.v1","course_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222","curric\u0075lum_revision":"sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa","lessons":[{"id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333","course_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222","section_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444","title":"L","description":"D","order":1,"status":1,"updated_at":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z","tasks":[{"id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555","lesson_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333","title":"T","description":"D","type":11,"assessment_purpose":"diagnostic","evaluation_mode":"AUTO","order":2,"status":1,"learning_targets":[{"type":"concept","key":"go.syntax","version":"v1"}],"updated_at":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z","version":1}]}]}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client = Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "write", DiagnosticCatalogToken: "secret", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	catalog, err := client.GetDiagnosticAssessmentCatalog(context.Background(), "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222")
	if err != nil || len(catalog.Assessments) != 1 || catalog.Assessments[0].LessonOrder != 1 || catalog.Revision[:7] != "sha256:" {
		t.Fatalf("catalog=%#v err=%v", catalog, err)
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticCatalogRejectsAdversarialCourseWire(t *testing.T) {
	base := fmt.Sprintf(`{"schema":"course-diagnostic-assessment-catalog.v1","course_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222","%s":"sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa","lessons":[{"id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333","course_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222","section_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444","title":"L","description":"D","order":1,"status":1,"updated_at":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z","tasks":[{"id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555","lesson_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333","title":"T","description":"D","type":11,"assessment_purpose":"diagnostic","evaluation_mode":"AUTO","order":2,"status":1,"learning_targets":[{"type":"concept","key":"go.syntax","version":"v1"}],"updated_at":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z","version":1}]}]}`, "curric"+"ulum_revision")
	cases := []struct {
		name, body, content string
		status              int
		want                error
	}{
		{"purpose", strings.Replace(base, "\"diagnostic\"", "\"knowledge_check\"", 1), "application/json", 200, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid},
		{"inactive", strings.Replace(base, "\"status\":1", "\"status\":0", 1), "application/json", 200, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid},
		{"type", strings.Replace(base, "\"type\":11", "\"type\":9", 1), "application/json", 200, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid},
		{"evaluation mode", strings.Replace(base, "\"evaluation_mode\":\"AUTO\"", "\"evaluation_mode\":\"MANUAL\"", 1), "application/json", 200, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid},
		{"evaluation mode wrong type", strings.Replace(base, "\"evaluation_mode\":\"AUTO\"", "\"evaluation_mode\":1", 1), "application/json", 200, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid},
		{"lesson", strings.Replace(base, "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333\",\"title\":\"T", "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999\",\"title\":\"T", 1), "application/json", 200, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid},
		{"duplicate", strings.Replace(base, "]}]}", `,{"id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555","lesson_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333","title":"T2","description":"D","type":11,"assessment_purpose":"diagnostic","evaluation_mode":"AUTO","order":3,"status":1,"learning_targets":[],"updated_at":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z","version":1}]}`, 1), "application/json", 200, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid},
		{"revision", strings.Replace(base, "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", "bad", 1), "application/json", 200, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid},
		{"content", base, "text/plain", 200, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid},
		{"trailing", base + "{}", "application/json", 200, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid},
		{"status", base, "application/json", 502, domain.ErrUpstreamUnavailable},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			s := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
				w.Header().Set("Content-Type", tc.content)
				w.WriteHeader(tc.status)
				_, _ = w.Write([]byte(tc.body))
			}))
			defer s.Close()
			_, err := Client{BaseURL: s.URL, InternalToken: "write", DiagnosticCatalogToken: "x", HTTPClient: s.Client()}.GetDiagnosticAssessmentCatalog(context.Background(), "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222")
			if !errors.Is(err, tc.want) {
				t.Fatalf("err=%v want=%v", err, tc.want)
			}
		})
	}
	// A response above the hard limit is never decoded.
	s := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(strings.Repeat("x", maximumResponseBytes+1)))
	}))
	defer s.Close()
	_, err := Client{BaseURL: s.URL, InternalToken: "write", DiagnosticCatalogToken: "x", HTTPClient: s.Client()}.GetDiagnosticAssessmentCatalog(context.Background(), "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222")
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid) {
		t.Fatalf("cap err=%v", err)
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticCatalogRejectsNonCanonicalCourseIDBeforeHTTP(t *testing.T) {
	calls := 0
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(http.ResponseWriter, *http.Request) { calls++ }))
	defer server.Close()
	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, DiagnosticCatalogToken: "diagnostic", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	for _, alias := range []string{"22222222-2222-4222-8222-22222222222A", " 22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"} {
		if _, err := client.GetDiagnosticAssessmentCatalog(context.Background(), alias); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) || calls != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("alias=%q err=%v calls=%d", alias, err, calls)
		}
	}
}
